violations.text: Allergen statement is lacking on the menu. Establishment must add allergen statement to menu. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen and dining room, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
Establishment is lacking proper drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine, and prep unit #1 have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026
The door to the kitchen toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet room doors must be self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026
